_doc: Skips the scientific gate accepts (scripts/ci/pytest_gate.py). Every other skip fails the gate: a missing R package, tool or fixture is missing coverage, not a platform difference. Add an entry only with a justification a reviewer can check.

approved_skips.justification: Reads a maintainer-local production run (V130-HISAT2). Real-data evidence is a release-checklist item, not a CI fixture.
The figure-review skill is deliberately not tracked in Git (commit 2520ef6).
Permission-denial tests cannot fail as root; GitHub-hosted runners run as a non-root user, so this applies only to root containers.
Linux procfs process start times; absent only in restricted sandboxes.
